features.name: Auth & Registration Pipeline
features.notes: 5-step wizard capturing identity, phone, wilaya, high school, and stream. Well implemented.

features.name: Legacy Onboarding Wizard
features.notes: 846 lines of orphaned code, duplicates /auth/register, completely disconnected from active navigation.

features.name: 72-Hour Free Trial Engine
features.notes: Tamper-proof server clock countdown. Restricts access to paywall when expired.

features.name: Stream Lock Enforcement
features.name_ar: قفل الشعبة الدراسية للوقاية من التشتت
features.notes: Prevents switching streams once chosen, preserving pedagogical focus.

features.name: Algerian High Schools Directory
features.notes: Functional autocomplete across 58 wilayas using official datasets.

features.name: Unlisted School Submission
features.notes: Frontend form works, but remote table high_school_submissions does not exist; data drops into local storage.

features.name: Diagnostic Assessment Engine
features.notes: Works отлично for Sciences Exp (15 questions) and Gestion (15 questions). Broken/Empty for Lettres & Philo (3 questions only).

features.name: Core Pedagogical Mission Loop (Sciences Exp)
features.notes: All 31 canonical skills have 14/14 assets ready (Lesson, Worked Example, Practice, Retest, Error Card, Repair Guide). Excellent.

features.name: Core Pedagogical Mission Loop (Gestion & Éco)
features.notes: 32 skills have synthetic mock MCQ options ('الإجابة الصحيحة', 'إجابة خاطئة شائعة', 'خيار بديل'). Not production ready.

features.name: Core Pedagogical Mission Loop (Lettres & Langues)
features.notes: Skills defined but 0 learning bundles exist. Attempting to start a mission renders 'Mission introuvable'.

features.name: Cognitive Error Lab & Misconception Repair
features.notes: Maps wrong answers to specific cognitive misconceptions with contrastive examples and isomorphic re-test twins.

features.name: Psychological Preparation & Mindset

features.name: Student Experiences Bank

features.name: Subscription Tier Enforcement & Paywall
